pet_notes: Q-version pixel sprite cat-ear girl pet, not an anime illustration. Use the attached sprite sheet only as a layout and clarity reference: simple classic game sprite sheet, thick outline, clear pose changes, stable scale and baseline, transparent or flat chroma background. Do not copy the reference creature, watermark, frame numbers, text, grid, checkerboard, or UI labels. Character must be a black cat-ear little girl with deep black hair, a few chunky pink highlights, pink eyes, simplified black gothic dress, small cat ears and small tail, tsundere but reliable expression. Main colors limited to black, dark gray, pink, and tiny white highlights. No complex hair strands, no complex clothing texture, no realistic lighting, no painterly rendering, no gradients, no background, no scenery, no text. Every frame readable at 192x208, same character design, same size, same position, same foot baseline. Semantic mapping for the Codex standard atlas: idle=breathing sway, running-right/rightward short-leg run, running-left/leftward short-leg run, waving=chat/wave, waiting=thinking head tilt without written punctuation, running=working at a tiny computer with hand motion, jumping=done happy hop, failed=sad apologetic collapse, review=sleeping or resting closed-eye pose while staying sprite-pet compatible.
style_notes: like the supplied example: classic small game sprite sheet, coarse pixel-art-like blocks, compact silhouette, thick dark outline, very few large details, readable motion, no complex anime rendering, no UI, no text in sprite cells
